correctness.rationale: For a planar iid rank-one orthogonal projector P with E P=I/2 and E(uᵀPu)²=3||u||⁴/8, A=I−ηP has exact directional squared contraction ρ=1−b/2 and quartic multiplier t4=1−b+3b²/8, b=η(2−η)>0. Synchronous coupling contracts W2 and quartic drift gives unique stationary finite fourth moment; q=(1−ρ)s enforces covariance sI. The homogeneous quartic operator contracts by t4, forcing a unique radial directional fourth moment m=3s²(8−2b)/(8−3b), so κ=3b/(8−3b)=3(1−ρ)/(1+3ρ). Since b≤1 with equality only η=1, fastest synchronous squared contraction ρ=1/2 has κ=3/5. Independent exact symbolic three-pair-projector design identities and 21 rational parameter cases corroborate. This says nothing about total variation or SDE discretization.
